what: ONE declaration of every platform format Layer 0 is distributed into. scripts/harness-x/render.mjs generates distribution/** (and regenerates the derived fields of public/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json and public/.well-known/mcp.json) from this file plus council-os/capabilities.json (the tools), mcp/gspc-server/server.json (the versions) and docs/DOCTRINE.md (verified against the pin below). Nothing here is published, submitted or registered: the owner does that, from distribution/SUBMIT.md. A sibling of capabilities.json rather than a block inside it, so capability-render --check and capability-registry validateShape stay untouched.
rules: No hand-typed counts. Every count in an output is the length of an array computed at render time.
No hand-typed server version. The remote version is read from mcp/gspc-server/server.json and scripts/harness-x/check.mjs requires it to equal the live serverInfo.version.
The doctrine is pinned by sha256. render refuses to run when docs/DOCTRINE.md no longer hashes to doctrine.sha256; re-pin deliberately with `node scripts/harness-x/render.mjs --pin-doctrine`.

Every artifact carries doctrine.sha256 in its declared carrier file(s). The doctrine TEXT stays here and in docs/DOCTRINE.md; outputs carry the hash and the source path, never a copy that can go stale.
Measurement only. No affirmative certification wording, no public price, verification free. check.mjs enforces all three over every output.

Every live channel is declared in published_channels[]. scripts/harness-x/parity_live.py reads each one live and states CONSISTENT / INCONSISTENT (quoting source and live) / UNCHECKABLE; a version number that already names published bytes is never reused for different bytes (PyPI and npm both refuse the re-upload).

doctrine.text:
# Doctrine — Council of AI

Independent measurement body (CSOAI Ltd, UK 16939677).  
Live board: `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`. Verify: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify.

1. **We measure. We do not certify.** No notified body, no conformity mark, no “Art 50 certified.”
2. **A grade is never sold.** Verify is free forever. Paid work is run / sign / attach / report.
3. **The card is isolated.** GSPC card-v1 preimage does not grow new kinds. Attachments hang off it by digest, each with its own `preimage_rule` and three states.
4. **UNMEASURED is first-class.** Empty cells stay empty. Do not guess. Quote slots and measurements together: live grammar is **22 · 15 · 7** until the stamped board says otherwise.
5. **Fail closed.** Missing stamp → UNCHECKABLE, never a cached LIVE.
6. **Bind, don’t migrate.** Pins and adapters. No 600-repo monorepo. Lifestyle MCPs are not the product.
7. **Mainnet copy needs stamp + law.** No GSPC credential as a grade. No token, bond, or “everyone gets a cut.”
8. **We eat our own cooking.** If we cannot verify it, we do not ship it.

Route: `client/src/pages/Doctrine.tsx` → `/doctrine` (lane `xrpl-hash-labels`). Live apex is **404** until this lane merges. Counts on the page come from `GET /api/gspc`, not typed.
